comparisons.peer_summary: AMD focuses its R&D on designing next-generation CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs, Adaptive SoCs, accelerators, SOMs, and SmartNICs, along with associated software and hardware design tools.
comparisons.comparison: Both MU and AMD disclose specific R&D focus areas centered on next-generation semiconductor products. MU emphasizes being 'well-positioned with our industry leading HBM3E technology' and developing 'new and fundamentally different memory structures, materials, and packages.' AMD similarly focuses its R&D on 'delivering the next generation of processors (CPU and GPU)... accelerators... and associated software.' Both companies explicitly link their R&D efforts to the development of next-generation products, though MU's specific focus is on memory structures and HBM, while AMD's is on CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators.

We are also focused on developing new and fundamentally different memory structures, materials, and packages designed to facilitate our transition to next generation products.

Our main area of focus is on delivering the next generation of processors (CPU and GPU), FPGAs and Adaptive SoCs, accelerators (adaptive, graphics and DPU), SOMs and SmartNICs and associated software.

We focus on designing, with security in mind, new integrated circuits (ICs) with improved performance and performance-per-watt in advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes, the design of logic and interface IP, advanced packaging technologies, and heterogeneous integration technologies.
